correctness.rationale: Smoothness via partial derivatives; c3(TX)=-2H^3 gives b3=10. Five nondegenerate fixed points for each nontrivial power of order-11 diagonal g give H3 trace -1. Fourier inversion gives ten distinct nontrivial eigenspaces. Arithmetic Frobenius conjugation by squaring gives one ten-cycle. Alternating cup product gives det Frob=2^15 and hence U^10+2^15. Grothendieck trace formula proves the zeta and all-extension counts. Standalone C++17 exact field counts independently agree for n=1..7; Python checker proves elementary congruences. No finite experiment is treated as proof of the infinite result.
